name: HRTS 2170W
title: Bioethics and Human Rights in Cross-Cultural Perspective
description: (Also offered as PHIL 2170W.) Philosophical examination of the ethical and human rights implications of recent advances in the life and biomedical sciences from multiple religious and cultural perspectives. CA 1.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to sophomores or higher.
